purpose: Second user-simulator robustness control for Bank U text-structure flips (GPT-6.1 review 5, option A).
scope: Robustness of continuations on FIXED histories generated with the old simulator (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). Only the user simulator after the fork state is replaced. It does NOT replace a full benchmark re-run with a new simulator, and makes no claim about Bank U rates under Sonnet.
blocks_note: f01 only: at freeze time f02/f03 had not landed for every cell (pending: ['q4_gptq_w4_d1/f03', 'q4_kvq_int8/f02', 'q4_kvq_int8/f03', 'q8_kvq_int8/f03']).
flip_rule: Bank U native rows of the listed blocks with taxonomy class (ii) (a_B, a_Q same tool structure, different text; sub-classes ii_talk = both talk, ii_act = same tool calls, different content) and M = |Y_BQ - Y_QQ| = 1; deduplicated within model x cell x block (a state in several sub-banks kept once: U1 > U2B > U2Q), as in W84.
matching_rule: 1:1 without replacement. Candidates: class (ii), M = 0, deduplicated, same model, cell, block, sub-bank and sub-class as the flip. Distance = |ln((1 + L_f) / (1 + L_c))| + |p_f - p_c|, L = mean whitespace-normalised character length of a_B and a_Q, p = t / n_decisions. Flips are processed in sha256('simctrl-v1|order|' + key) order; ties broken by sha256('simctrl-v1|tie|' + flip key + '|' + candidate key). key = model|cell|block|sub|state_key.
user_llm_params_note: model id claude-sonnet-5-5 via litellm 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5' (tau2's own UserSimulator, system prompt and stop logic unchanged). temperature: NOT settable (the model rejects non-default sampling with a 400), so the API default applies; seed: not supported (the orchestrator's seed is dropped and the drop recorded); thinking off via {'type': 'between_tools'} (default effort high); max_tokens 512 = the old simulator's. No server-side refusal fallback (it would change the simulator model). Request ids and token usage are recorded per user call. One Sonnet run per arm.

branches.BQ: a_B (recorded in the Bank U row) forced at h_t, then the cell's Q controller
branches.QQ: a_Q (recorded) forced at h_t, then the cell's Q controller
branches.servers: B = BF16 (only to regenerate a_B as a reconstruction check), Q = the cell's exact serving config
branches.Y: retail/airline: db_match and termination in (user_stop, agent_stop) (fork_driver._y)
branches.replicates: R = 3 independent Sonnet runs per arm (BQ and QQ) per unit, flips and controls alike; replicate r of BQ is paired with replicate r of QQ; results keyed '<arm>#<r>'.

acceptance_gate.task: simctrl_gate_q4_gptq_w4_d1 (3 manifest units of q4 GPTQ-W4 d1, first 3 by sha256 order; R = 3)
checks: state rebuilt: history_sha and prompt_ids_sha equal the Bank U row; B regenerates a_B and Q regenerates a_Q exactly

user protocol: every branch's first Sonnet request has system-prompt sha == tau2 UserSimulator system prompt built from the task's user instructions, and its message list starts with the flipped user-visible history (role, content)
tool interface: retail/airline user has no tools (request carries none); telecom is not in Bank U
hidden user state: the system prompt carries the task instructions; env hash at init == state env hash; prefix_ok
termination: a user_stop branch ends on a user message containing ###STOP### / ###TRANSFER### / ###OUT-OF-SCOPE###, and no earlier user message contains one
every user call is anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 with a request id and usage; no API errors
acceptance_gate.rule: Analysis is run only if the gate passes (analyze_simctrl.py refuses otherwise).

analysis_plan.flips: Primary: retained = sign(Dbar) == s; reversed = sign(Dbar) == -s; vanished = Dbar == 0. Shown with the per-replicate distribution: per unit the number of replicates (0..R) with D_r == s, == -s, == 0, and per replicate r the retained / reversed / vanished counts.
analysis_plan.controls: Newly appearing flip = Dbar != 0 (direction = sign(Dbar)); also per replicate r the counts with D_r != 0, and per unit the number of replicates (0..R) with D_r != 0.
analysis_plan.paired: Per pair: (flip retained, control newly flips) cross-tab; descriptive.
analysis_plan.secondary: Arm-level agreement Y'_arm == Y_arm per arm and role; termination reasons; Sonnet token usage and cost.
analysis_plan.no_threshold: No pass/fail threshold on retention is pre-specified; counts with exact binomial 95% intervals are reported.
analysis_plan.missing: A unit with any errored replicate of either arm is missing for the primary (never imputed); per-replicate tables use the complete replicates.
analysis_plan.estimand: Per unit, per replicate r: signed flip D_r = Y'_BQ,r - Y'_QQ,r in {-1, 0, +1}. Replicate-mean flip indicator Dbar = mean_r D_r. Original direction s = +1 (rescue) / -1 (damage).
analysis_plan.variability: Within-simulator outcome variability: per arm (BQ, QQ) and role, the share of units whose R replicates of Y' are not all equal (Clopper-Pearson 95%).

amends.reason: claude-sonnet-5-5 has no temperature 0 and no seed, so one run per arm confounds retained / reversed / vanished with simulator sampling noise. Units, matching, user_llm and the gate checks are unchanged.
